name: tovu-theme
description: Builds Tovu themes two ways: scaffolds a new theme (static, templated or declarative tier; hand-authored, or compiled from a React/Vue/Angular build), or converts an existing static website (plain HTML/CSS/JS, no Tovu, no CMS) into a Tovu static-tier theme. Encodes the theme-format rules a generic approach gets wrong: apiVersion 2's render/pages+render/partials+css/theme.css+scripts layout, the manifest keys the live loader actually reads (slots, flat modes/defaultMode) versus planned ones it ignores, which of tokens.json/tokens.light.json holds which palette regardless of the source's own default, the publishedPages allow-list that leaves every non-index page unreachable until explicitly turned on, the narrow href=/src= sentinel rewrite that never touches a JS fetch() call, a compiled build's required artifactHashes, and the hard boundary around binary assets that no agent tool in this product can copy. No new tools — everything runs on fs_read_file/fs_list_files plus the existing theme_* file tools.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary:
Builds a design (a theme) for your site. The assistant can start a new theme from scratch, or turn a website you already have into a Tovu theme.

When it converts an existing site, extra pages stay hidden until you turn them on, and images and fonts need to be added separately. The assistant tells you which ones.
